target: A coherent candidate for multimodal references, long narratives and local editing; not Seedance reverse engineering

base.scheduler_policy: native short baseline retained; bounded long-sequence shift is an explicit candidate override

time.latent_position: native codec coverage and temporal coordinates

example_request.training_padding_policy: Track valid pixels/frames and latent receptive fields; do not drop a whole mixed last latent as a substitute

reference_memory.budget_scope: pooled identity/style summaries; aligned fixed soundtrack uses full native audio tokens separately
reference_memory.fusion: new gated cross-attention after every fourth native block, pilot choice
reference_memory.time_gate: explicit soft interval bias; not a claimed WeRoPE reproduction
reference_memory.subject_query_policy: shot-level allowed subject set by default; spatial hard mask only with layout/source tracking/reliable predicted regions available at inference
reference_memory.empty_condition: always-visible null token or skip new branch
reference_memory.motion_only_video: pose/flow/camera context path; appearance tokens disabled by role

source_condition.encoding: independent asset VAE encode then native-grid-aligned context projection
source_condition.known_target_clamp: optional separate policy with fixed noise path, matched in training
source_condition.strict_preservation: reuse source pixels/audio outside authorized output edit range

task_states.policy_status: New conditional modes must be represented during training; not inference-only switches

causal_extension.between_blocks: past/current only in self and AV cross attention
causal_extension.block_assignment: native position intervals plus actual preprocessing/encoder dependency end; defer and buffer boundary-straddling tokens
causal_extension.cache_write: recompute completed block as clean sigma-zero context; do not reuse final noisy-step KVs
causal_extension.decoder: offline whole-sequence decode first; native noncausal decoder needs lookahead or separate causal design for streaming
causal_extension.rollout_supervision: teacher relabels continuation conditional on actual student history; reject state conflicts

training.initial_sigma_sampling: native short joint baseline; bounded candidate long policy is specified separately; clean condition modes trained explicitly
training.loss: per-sample valid-element mean; then valid-sample mean per task/modality with global distributed counts; plus task-specific region/preservation
training.optimizer_estimate_scope: 19B*16 bytes, decimal GB, excludes activations/text/VAEs/communication; not a measured requirement

sigma_policy.candidate_long: 90% shifted logit-normal with shift clipped [0.95,2.05] +10% uniform sigma
sigma_policy.inference: matched bounded shift plus native endpoint handling; requires comparison

lora_candidate.targets: full module names for native self and AV to_q/to_v only; exclude text attention and new branches

training.recovery: all new modules plus LoRA, optimizer, scheduler, RNG, sampler cursor, task/sigma/data versions

unverified_gates: reference compression retains small identity/product/voice details
new role and interval controls generalize to unseen scenes
joint 30-second quality remains stable through final seconds
local edit targets change while keep regions remain valid
speaker references match voice without copying unintended words/music
causal model matches its cache dependencies and long-rollout training distribution
actual hardware and delivery costs meet task constraints

adapter_contract.initialization: normal projections, zero scalar gates, no output bias
adapter_contract.source_tower: aligned lightweight depthwise temporal/spatial residual blocks; no dynamic target input

delivery_contract.strict_preservation_scope: pre-encoding pixel/PCM working representation; lossy re-encode does not guarantee byte equality

plan_scope.primary_direction: stable joint backbone; task data and application adaptation first; limited condition plugins only for interface gaps
plan_scope.closed_service_route: external workflow/tools/data evaluation only; no assumed access to internal adapters, LoRA or continued training
plan_scope.open_reference_route: matched public base; task data, native adaptation, then missing condition plugins
plan_scope.primary_long_video_route: joint long context plus separately evaluated shot orchestration
plan_scope.causal_extension: optional separately trained derivative; not a prerequisite for the first application
plan_scope.cost_examples: illustrative inputs only; no verified Seedance prices or GPU measurements
